subject: biology-2
question: A warm-blooded animal with hair feeds its newborn a nutrient fluid produced by special glands. Which feature, found in essentially all living mammals, is the defining innovation that separates them from every other vertebrate class?
explanation: Mammary glands and the milk they produce define mammals, and essentially all living mammals nurse their young. A post-anal tail is a chordate feature shared with other classes, the amniotic egg also occurs in reptiles and birds, and four limbs are widespread among tetrapods, so A, B, and C fail.
